values.problem: declares `kind` `syndicated`, which is not one of `first_party`, `third_party`, `marketplace`, `imported`, `undisclosed`

findings.message: `pagefront:reviewSource` on review `https://merchant.example/reviews/r-88102` at `$['data']['itemListElement'][2]['pagefront:reviewSource']` declares `kind` `syndicated`, which is not one of `first_party`, `third_party`, `marketplace`, `imported`, `undisclosed`.
findings.remediation: Declare `pagefront:reviewSource` on every review as an object whose `kind` is `first_party`, `third_party`, `marketplace`, `imported` or `undisclosed`, with the platform's `name` and the review's `url` for a third-party or marketplace source.
